text: Because quarterly Form PF filing costs roughly $10,000 per reporting fund, the $1.5 billion threshold that triggers quarterly filing gives advisers a direct cost reason to factor that threshold into the AUM decision.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479

isBasedOn.name: The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2

abstract: At an average quarterly cost of around $10,000 for each reporting fund, the Form PF190 costs may make participants more likely to consider the Form PF reporting threshold in the AUM decision.
